conclusion: Gate precision does not collapse cross distribution; conditional rescue collapses. This does not establish task difficulty as the causal mechanism. On L, 119/148 gated trajectories changed yet only 1/148 became correct. This is retrospective, not a new prospective evaluation.
limitations: K and L differ in source distribution, prompt type, difficulty and code execution semantics; do not interpret as a randomized trial.
The comparison and strata are exploratory and exposed to post-selection/multiple comparisons.
Do not adjust LCB-v6 threshold, bias, prompt or decoding to exploit this result.
